tasks.prompt: With standard Unix (Vixie) cron, does the expression '0 0 13 * 5' fire on Friday 2026-11-06? Answer yes or no.
When does the Unix cron expression '0 9 * * 1-5' (UTC) next fire after 2026-09-26T12:00:00Z? Give the time in ISO 8601 UTC.
Does the cron expression '0 0 30 2 *' ever fire? Answer yes or no.
The cron expression '*/7 * * * *' fires at minute 56 of an hour. How many minutes later is its next run? Give the number only.
In a GitHub Actions workflow, will a schedule of cron '*/2 * * * *' actually run every 2 minutes? Answer yes or no.
A Unix cron job '30 2 * * *' runs in the America/New_York time zone. Does 02:30 local time exist on 2026-03-08, so the job fires at its normal time that day? Answer yes or no.
Convert the Unix cron expression '0 9 * * 1-5' into an AWS EventBridge cron expression. Give the expression only.
On which day of the week does the AWS EventBridge schedule 'cron(15 10 ? * 2 *)' run? Give the day name only.
When does the Quartz cron expression '0 15 10 ? * 6L' next fire after 2026-09-26T12:00:00Z (UTC)? Give the date as YYYY-MM-DD.
In Quartz cron's day-of-week field, which day is 1? Give the day name only.
